senses.sense_definition: Amusement, enjoyment, or pleasure derived from an activity.

examples.text: We had so much <w>fun</w> at the beach yesterday.

target_lang_translations.zh: 昨天我们在海滩玩得非常<w>开心</w>。

target_lang_translations.de: Wir hatten gestern am Strand so viel <w>Spaß</w>.
target_lang_translations.fr: Nous nous sommes tellement <w>amusés</w> à la plage hier.
target_lang_translations.it: Ci siamo <w>divertiti</w> tantissimo in spiaggia ieri.
target_lang_translations.cs: Včera na pláži jsme si užili tolik <w>zábavy</w>.
target_lang_translations.es: Nos <w>divertimos</w> mucho en la playa ayer.

examples.text: The children are having <w>fun</w> playing in the garden.

target_lang_translations.zh: 孩子们在花园里玩得很<w>开心</w>。

target_lang_translations.it: I bambini si stanno <w>divertendo</w> a giocare in giardino.
target_lang_translations.es: Los niños se están <w>divirtiendo</w> jugando en el jardín.

target_lang_definitions.ru: Удовольствие, радость или наслаждение, получаемое от какой-либо деятельности.
target_lang_definitions.zh: 从活动中获得的乐趣、喜悦或享受。

target_lang_definitions.pl: Przyjemność, radość lub satysfakcja czerpana z jakiejś aktywności.

target_lang_definitions.fr: Plaisir, joie ou divertissement tiré d'une activité.
target_lang_definitions.it: Divertimento, piacere o gioia derivanti da un'attività.
target_lang_definitions.cs: Potěšení, radost nebo zábava plynoucí z nějaké činnosti.
target_lang_definitions.tr: Bir etkinlikten elde edilen eğlence, keyif veya zevk.
target_lang_definitions.es: Placer, alegría o entretenimiento derivado de una actividad.

senses.sense_definition: Playful, often noisy, activity or behavior.

examples.text: The party was full of <w>fun</w> and games for everyone.

target_lang_translations.fr: La fête était pleine d'<w>amusements</w> et de jeux pour tout le monde.

target_lang_translations.ru: Прекратите это <w>веселье</w> и возню, пока кто-нибудь не пострадал.

examples.text: He is such a <w>fun</w> person to be around.

senses.sense_definition: To tease, kid, or joke with someone in a playful way.

examples.text: Don't get angry; I was only <w>funning</w> you about your haircut.

target_lang_translations.zh: 别生气，我只是拿你的发型跟你<w>开玩笑</w>。

target_lang_translations.de: Sei nicht böse; ich habe dich wegen deines Haarschnitts nur <w>aufgezogen</w>.
target_lang_translations.fr: Ne te fâche pas ; je ne faisais que te <w>taquiner</w> à propos de ta coupe de cheveux.
target_lang_translations.it: Non arrabbiarti; stavo solo <w>scherzando</w> sul tuo taglio di capelli.
